title: Punctured local purity makes depth-two finite extensions flat
statement: Let p:E -> L be finite with L locally Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and etale over an open V [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Suppose both target stalks outside V and source stalks above the complement have depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Assume punctured local purity at every point outside V: every finite etale cover of the punctured spectrum of that stalk extends to a finite etale cover of the entire local spectrum. Then p is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism].

source.place: Tag 0EY7, purity implies extension, applied to a supplied depth-two finite extension; minimal nonflat fibre argument

proof.text: Let W be the open target locus where all finite source stalk maps are flat. The etale restriction implies V is contained in W.

If the closed complement of W is nonempty, choose an irreducible component and its generic point s. Schemes are sober; maximality of that component implies any point of the complement generalizing s equals s. Thus every proper generalization of s lies in W.

The point s is outside V, so use its depth bound and punctured local purity. The local fibre flatness theorem applied to all its flat proper generalizations makes the whole fibre above s flat. This puts s in W, a contradiction. Therefore W is the entire target and the stalk criterion gives Flat p.

lean.statement:
theorem flat_of_local_purity_depth_two_finite_extension
    {L E : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (V : L.Opens)
    (hdepth : ∀ y : L, y ∉ V →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := L.presheaf.stalk y) (L.presheaf.stalk y))
    (hpurity : ∀ y : L, y ∉ V →
      ∀ (U : (Spec (L.presheaf.stalk y)).Opens),
        (∀ x : Spec (L.presheaf.stalk y),
          x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint (L.presheaf.stalk y)) →
        ∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (q : Z ⟶ U.toScheme), IsFinite q → Etale q →
          ∃ (F : Scheme.{u}) (r : F ⟶ Spec (L.presheaf.stalk y)),
            IsFinite r ∧ Etale r ∧
              ∃ e : Z ≅ (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme, e.hom ≫ r ∣_ U = q)
    (p : E ⟶ L) [IsFinite p] [Etale (p ∣_ V)]
    (hsource : ∀ z : E, p z ∉ V →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := E.presheaf.stalk z) (E.presheaf.stalk z)) :
    Flat p
